summary: Accepted fixed SkillSwap scenario for Decomposition. Two-sided marketplace: providers, learners, bookings, payments, admin vetting. Constraints: instant search, no double-booking, testable cancellation, consistent commission/payout, multi-city without rebuild.
evidence: Do not switch mid-bootcamp. Domain objects stay: provider, service, slot, booking, payment, dispute.
Artifact chain named: requirements -> DAG -> risk plan -> slices -> tickets -> parallel plan -> adaptation -> integration.
Hard constraints listed: search latency, slot uniqueness, cancellation contract, commission consistency, city expansion.
